title: Reading Drill — Protecting Records from a Leak
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Protecting Records from a Leak
passages.body:
**A** An archive kept a floor plan listing the pipes above its store. When a leak appeared near a wall, staff checked which pipe ran above the spot before moving all of the nearby boxes to safety.

**B** The pipe was sound and the actual source was water entering around a skylight. Staff inspected the roof after the next rain and found a gap beside a metal trim, where the seal had lifted.

**C** Most boxes stayed dry. For the damp documents, one volunteer numbered the folders and recorded their order before taking them out of the damaged boxes. That record helped the team put the collection back together.
